home.lead: Stands, Hamon and vampirism in Minecraft.
home.leadMore: A JoJo's Bizarre Adventure combat mod for Fabric and NeoForge.
home.note: Not released yet. Public beta planned for CurseForge and Modrinth.
home.standsText: Use a Stand Arrow on yourself. Your Worthiness decides whether it sticks.
home.pathsText: Learn Hamon, put on the Stone Mask, or go further. Each path has its own moves and its own price.
home.roadmapText: No release dates until the public beta is finalized.
home.joinText: Sneak peeks, announcements and tester applications all happen in the server.

stands.name: Star Platinum
stands.text: Fast, precise and strong. Rushes targets down with barrages, then stretches a finger out for the finish.

moves.name: Uppercut
moves.short: A rising blow that launches the target.
moves.text: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 7 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Grab
moves.short: Grabs a target to throw or set down.
moves.text: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Star Finger
moves.short: A long finger jab along your aim.
moves.text: Extends a finger 10 blocks along your aim for 7 damage. 2.25s cooldown.

moves.name: Skull Crusher
moves.short: Crushes one target and throws it.
moves.text: Crushes one target within 4.5 blocks for 8 damage and throws it. Stuns 3 seconds, 1.5 seconds on players. 7s cooldown.

moves.name: Inhale
moves.short: Hold to pull everything nearby toward you.
moves.text: Hold to pull everything within 14 blocks to you for 8 seconds. Puts out fire, cools lava. Sneak to blow. 6s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Skip
moves.short: Steps forward through stopped time.
moves.text: Steps 12 blocks forward through stopped time. Needs Time Stop. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Stop
moves.short: Stops time for a few seconds.
moves.text: Charge, then release to stop time up to 5 seconds. A hit breaks the charge. 3 uses a fight. 20s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Stop: Extended
moves.short: Stops time for a second longer.
moves.text: Stops time for up to 6 seconds instead of 5. 35s cooldown.

moves.name: 2 Meters
moves.short: Your Stand's next close blow hits harder.
moves.text: Your Stand's next blow deals 1.3x within 2 blocks, fading to normal by 9. Recharges over 4 seconds.

moves.name: Sensory Perception
moves.text: Marks containers within 12 blocks through walls and floors.

moves.name: Star Guard
moves.short: At low health, guarding restores Stand energy.
moves.text: At 20% health or less, every blow your Stand's guard absorbs restores 10% of its energy.

moves.name: Enhanced Reflexes
moves.short: Deflects a mob's blow when your health is low.
moves.text: At 40% health or less, deflects one blow a mob throws from within 4 blocks. Recovers over 3.5 seconds, down to 1.5 seconds at high Protection.

moves.name: Unwavering
moves.short: Resists knockback, more so when hurt.
moves.text: 50% knockback resistance, rising to 90% below half health. Blows no longer interrupt you.

moves.name: Two Meters II
moves.text: Full 1.3x damage out to 4 blocks instead of 2.

moves.name: Sensory Perception II
moves.text: Marks containers within 22 blocks instead of 12.

stands.name: The World
stands.text: Muda rushes, knife volleys and a Time Stop you charge up. The longer you hold it, the longer time stays frozen.

moves.name: Uppercut
moves.short: A rising blow that launches the target.
moves.text: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 7 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Grab
moves.short: Grabs a target to throw or set down.
moves.text: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Ground Breaker
moves.short: Dives on a spot and launches everything near it.
moves.text: Dives onto a marked spot 8 blocks ahead. A wave launches everything within 7.5 blocks for 7 damage. 8s cooldown.

moves.name: Knife Barrage
moves.short: Throws knives: tap to fan, hold to focus, sneak to chain.
moves.text: Tap to fan 8 knives in a 70 degree arc for 2 damage each. Hold to send all 8 into one target. Sneak to throw them one by one, every 0.3 seconds, each straight at your target. 7s cooldown.

moves.name: Kick Flurry
moves.short: Hold for a stream of kicks that push and lift.
moves.text: Replaces Barrage. Hold for kicks: 12 per 2.4 seconds at 0.9 damage, pushing and lifting. Stops at 14. 7s cooldown.

moves.name: Beatdown
moves.short: Holds a target, pummels it, then throws it.
moves.text: Replaces Grab. Holds a target within 4.5 blocks and hits 8 times for 2.2, then throws for 8. 9s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Stop
moves.short: Stops time for a few seconds.
moves.text: Charge, then release to stop time up to 5 seconds. A hit breaks the charge. 3 uses a fight. 20s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Stop: Perfect
moves.short: A longer Time Stop. Vampires only.
moves.text: Replaces Time Stop. Stops time for up to 8 seconds instead of 5. Only a vampire can learn or use it. 40s cooldown.

moves.name: Time Skip
moves.short: Steps forward through stopped time.
moves.text: Steps 12 blocks forward through stopped time. Needs Time Stop. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Enhanced Reflexes
moves.short: Deflects a mob's blow when your health is low.
moves.text: At 40% health or less, deflects one blow a mob throws from within 4 blocks. Recovers over 3.5 seconds, down to 1.5 seconds at high Protection.

moves.name: Unwavering
moves.short: Resists knockback, more so when hurt.
moves.text: 50% knockback resistance, rising to 90% below half health. Blows no longer interrupt you.

moves.name: Master of Time
moves.short: Slowing effects and Stun wear off sooner.
moves.text: Slowness, Mining Fatigue and Stun wear off 20% sooner on you.

moves.name: Crushing Force
moves.short: At low health, blows break through guards.
moves.text: Below 25% health, blows against a guard deal 1.25x damage and knock a raised shield down.

stands.name: Hermit Purple
stands.text: Thorny vines that grab, pull and swing. Also good for dowsing and finding things.

moves.name: Hermit Grapple
moves.short: Throws a vine that anchors in stone and holds you.
moves.text: Throws a vine that bites into stone and holds you. Jump to climb, sneak to pay out slack, press again to let go.

moves.name: Thorn Zip
moves.short: Vines from both arms haul you to one anchor.
moves.text: Fires a vine from each arm at one anchor and hauls you to it. Ends on arrival. 1.3s cooldown.

moves.name: Lasso of Thorns
moves.short: Loops a vine round a creature and leads it.
moves.text: Loops a vine around anything living within 12 blocks and leads it. Press again to let go. 1s cooldown.

moves.name: Camera Crush
moves.short: Crushes a placed camera and develops a map from it.
moves.text: Crushes a placed camera and reads a map from what develops. Reaches 8 blocks. Costs the camera. 6s cooldown.

moves.name: Clairvoyance
moves.short: See life, ore and chests through stone for a while.
moves.text: Sees through stone 12 seconds: life within 48 blocks, ore and chests within 24. Only you see it. 30s cooldown.

moves.name: Thorn Whip
moves.short: Snaps the vine out and flings the target away.
moves.text: Snaps the vine out to 13 blocks for 4.2 damage and flings the target away. Replaces Lasso of Thorns. 2.25s cooldown.

moves.name: Twisting Gut Punch
moves.short: Hauls a distant target in and punches the wind out of it.
moves.text: Hauls one target from up to 11 blocks in and punches it for 7.5 damage. Winded for 2.25 seconds. 3.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Dowsing
moves.short: Vines crawl toward the nearest ore.
moves.text: Braided vines crawl along the ground toward the nearest ore within 32 blocks and dive in above it; the ore glows for you once they arrive. Hold an ore block to dowse for that ore only. Utility stance. 10s cooldown.

moves.name: Grappling Vine
moves.short: Faster on foot, with softer falls.
moves.text: 12% faster on foot, harder to knock out of the air, and 45% of fall damage ignored.

moves.name: Tangled
moves.short: Strikes can leave thorns that block the target's moves.
moves.text: Your strikes have an 18% chance to leave thorns in. Blocks 3 of the target's moves for 2.5 seconds.

moves.name: Thornbind
moves.short: The vine's strikes cause Bleed.
moves.text: The vine leaves its thorns in. What it strikes bleeds for 5 seconds.

moves.name: Second Sight
moves.text: Clairvoyance lasts 1.75x as long and comes back 25% sooner.

moves.name: Ripple Conduction
moves.short: With Hamon, vine moves hit the undead harder.
moves.text: With Hamon, the vine conducts. Thorn Whip and Twisting Gut Punch deal 6 more to the undead.

moves.name: Made For This
moves.short: Harmful effects wear off faster.
moves.text: Harmful effects wear off 1 second faster every 3 seconds, down to a floor of 2 seconds.

moves.name: Unorthodox Method
moves.short: This Stand grows by being out, not by kills.
moves.text: This Stand grows by being used. 1 point every 5 seconds it is out, rather than by killing with it.

moves.name: Grappling Vine II
moves.short: Faster still, and falls hurt far less.
moves.text: 24% faster on foot instead of 12%, and 80% of fall damage ignored instead of 45%.

stands.name: Hierophant Green
stands.text: Fires emerald shots from a distance, lays tendril traps, and can possess the body of whoever it catches.

moves.name: Uppercut
moves.short: A rising blow that launches the target.
moves.text: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 7 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Grab
moves.short: Grabs a target to throw or set down.
moves.text: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Emerald Splash Shotgun Blast
moves.short: Fires a tight blast of emerald shards where you aim.
moves.text: Fires 3 emerald shards at high pressure where you aim, 7 damage each. 5.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Emerald Splash Barrage
moves.short: Hold to gather, release a stream of shards along your aim.
moves.text: Hold to gather, release a stream of shards that follows your aim. At 30% health, the Final Emerald Splash. 8s cooldown.

moves.name: Tendril Spike
moves.short: Tentacles burst from the ground and toss your target.
moves.text: Two tentacles burst out of the ground, closing on your target from both sides. 6 damage and a toss. 6s cooldown.

moves.name: Web Swing
moves.short: Hold to swing from a tentacle; let go to fly.
moves.text: Hold to throw a tentacle at a wall or roof and swing from it. Let go to fly.

moves.name: Unravel Trap
moves.short: Lays a web on the floor that entangles what steps in.
moves.text: Unravels into a web on the floor where you look. Anything that steps in is entangled, 3 damage. Lasts 30s. 15s cooldown.

moves.name: Miniature Trap
moves.short: Strings a tripwire that entangles the first through.
moves.text: Strings a tripwire from the block you look at to the far side. The first through is entangled, 4 damage. 3s cooldown.

moves.name: Body Possession
moves.short: Steer the body you look at and wear it down.
moves.text: Steer the body you look at. Mob: 5 damage every 5s. Player: 3s, then 8 damage. Stand users at half health. 30s cooldown.

moves.name: 20 Meter Radius Emerald Splash
moves.short: A sphere of tendrils that shoots anything moving inside.
moves.text: A sphere of tendrils 20 blocks round you. Anything moving inside is shot from every side. Lasts 20s. 60s cooldown.

moves.name: Deadeye
moves.short: Ranged attacks hit harder from farther away.
moves.text: Ranged attacks hit harder the farther they were thrown from: nothing extra inside 8 blocks, up to 1.25x at 24.

moves.name: Opportunist
moves.short: Ranged attacks hit distracted targets harder.
moves.text: Ranged attacks deal 1.2x damage to anything busy fighting someone else.

moves.name: Emerald Splash
moves.short: Shards that hit can burst into fragments.
moves.text: A shard that hits has a 25% chance to burst through into 4 fragments at 40% damage, flying on along its line.

moves.name: Rebound
moves.short: Shards ricochet off the first block they hit.
moves.text: Shards ricochet off the first block they hit, at 80% damage. Bank them off walls to reach round corners.

stands.name: Magician's Red
stands.text: Controls the battlefield with rings and domes of flame. Red Bind holds targets in place.

moves.name: Uppercut
moves.short: A rising blow that launches the target.
moves.text: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 7 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Grab
moves.short: Grabs a target to throw or set down.
moves.text: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Sweep Kick
moves.short: Magician's Red sweeps the legs of everything near it.
moves.text: Magician's Red darts ahead and sweeps its leg through everything within 3 blocks: 5 damage, a stagger and a small launch. 6s cooldown.

moves.name: Crossfire Hurricane
moves.short: Fires a flaming ankh.
moves.text: Magician's Red breathes a flaming ankh that flies where you look: 6 damage and Burning to the first enemy hit. 8s cooldown.

moves.name: Crossfire Hurricane Special
moves.short: Fires a barrage of 5 flaming ankhs.
moves.text: Magician's Red breathes 5 flaming ankhs one after another, each dealing 3.5 damage and Burning. 18s cooldown.

moves.name: Red Bind
moves.short: Ties an enemy in place with ropes of flame.
moves.text: Ropes of flame tie the enemy you look at, up to 10 blocks away: held in place for 2 seconds and set Burning. 14s cooldown.

moves.name: Controlled Blaze
moves.short: Wraps a ring of fire around the spot you look at.
moves.text: Magician's Red flies to where you look, up to 14 blocks away, and wraps a ring of fire 4.5 blocks wide around the spot for 12 seconds. Enemies touching the wall take 2 damage every half second and start Burning. Inside the ring is your area. 20s cooldown.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.short: Inside your area, hit harder and set Burning for a short time.
moves.text: Only inside your own area. For 12 seconds Magician's Red hits 25% harder and every hit sets Burning. 30s cooldown.

moves.name: Containment
moves.short: Draws a wall of fire that follows where you look.
moves.text: For 1.5 seconds a wall of fire rises along the ground where you look, up to 12 blocks away. Turn your view to bend it; it can run 16 blocks. It stands for 10 seconds, and enemies touching it take 2 damage every half second, gain Burning and are pushed back. One wall at a time. 16s cooldown.

moves.name: Life Sense
moves.short: A heat radar that shows living things through walls.
moves.text: Magician's Red raises a cross of flame pointing six ways. For 6 seconds you see every living thing within 24 blocks through walls. 15s cooldown.

moves.name: Increase Temperature
moves.short: Burns or smelts the blocks around Magician's Red.
moves.text: Heats up to 48 blocks within 4 blocks of Magician's Red into their burnt or smelted form: grass to dirt, sand to glass, cobblestone to stone, ice to water. 10s cooldown.

moves.name: Infinite Inferno Fire
moves.short: A dome of fire and ash that burns the enemies inside it.
moves.text: Raises a dome of fire and ash 9 blocks around you for 2 minutes 30 seconds. Enemies inside are slowed and gain a stack of Burning every 2 seconds. The dome is your area. 5 minute cooldown.

moves.name: Finger Snap
moves.short: Snaps out all your fire at once.
moves.text: Snap your fingers: every Magician's Flame within 32 blocks goes out at once, and your burning areas, walls and Inferno end. 2s cooldown.

moves.name: Territorial
moves.short: Stronger and faster inside your own area.
moves.text: Inside an area made by your Stand, its attacks deal 15% more damage and you move faster.

moves.name: Encroachment
moves.short: Your area slowly grows while you stay in it.
moves.text: While you stand inside your area it grows 0.1 blocks a second, up to 50% larger.

moves.name: Flame Immunity
moves.short: Your own flames do not burn you.
moves.text: Magician's Red's flames never hurt you, and inside your own area you cannot burn.

moves.name: Burning Pressure
moves.short: Burning enemies are easier to stagger.
moves.text: Magician's Red's attacks have a 30% chance to stagger an enemy that is Burning.

stands.name: Silver Chariot
stands.text: A rapier fighter built on hit chains. Throw off the armour to get faster.

moves.name: Uppercut
moves.short: A rising blow that launches the target.
moves.text: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 7 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Grab
moves.short: Grabs a target to throw or set down.
moves.text: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Balestra
moves.short: Chariot lunges, skewers the first thing hit and stuns it.
moves.text: Chariot lunges up to 6 blocks ahead. The first thing it runs through takes 6 damage, is held on the blade while Chariot twists it for 3 more, and is stunned for 1.25 seconds. 8s cooldown.

moves.name: Blade Launch
moves.short: Shoots the rapier's blade at what you look at.
moves.text: Chariot shoots the blade off its rapier at what you look at, 8 damage. It fights bladeless until the blade lands. 12s cooldown.

moves.name: Sabre Cycle
moves.short: Hold to wind up, release to slash all around you.
moves.text: Hold to wind up, release for a slash all around you: 4 damage within 2.5 blocks, growing to 9 within 5 blocks at 2 seconds. 10s cooldown.

moves.name: Deflection
moves.short: Hold to turn attacks and projectiles back from the front.
moves.text: Hold for up to 3 seconds to deflect attacks from the front. Attackers are thrown back and projectiles fly back at the shooter. Each deflection costs energy. 6s cooldown.

moves.name: Riposte
moves.short: A brief counter: Chariot slips behind and slashes.
moves.text: Opens a 0.6 second counter. If you are struck in it, the blow misses and Chariot appears behind the attacker for a 7 damage slash and a stagger. 8s cooldown.

moves.name: Armor Release
moves.short: Sheds the armour: faster, but you take more damage.
moves.text: Chariot bursts out of its armour: you move and swing 20% faster and its flurry quickens, but you take 25% more damage. Use again to re-armour. 10s cooldown.

moves.name: Afterimages
moves.short: Armour off: afterimages may take hits meant for you.
moves.text: Armour off only. Chariot splits into 5 afterimages for 10 seconds, and each attack has a 40% chance to strike one instead of you. 20s cooldown.

moves.name: Piercing Thrust
moves.short: Sword hits can pierce armor, always on exposed targets.
moves.text: Sword hits have a 25% chance to ignore 25% more of the target's armor. A fully charged Sabre Cycle, or any hit on a stunned or guard-broken target, always ignores 40% more.

moves.name: Enhanced Reflexes
moves.short: Deflects a mob's blow when your health is low.
moves.text: At 40% health or less, deflects one blow a mob throws from within 4 blocks. Recovers over 3.5 seconds, down to 1.5 seconds at high Protection.

moves.name: Unwavering
moves.short: Resists knockback, more so when hurt.
moves.text: 50% knockback resistance, rising to 90% below half health. Blows no longer interrupt you.

moves.name: Duelist's Focus
moves.short: Raising your guard parries first.
moves.text: Raising Silver Chariot's guard opens a 4-tick parry before it settles into a block. The parry turns melee hits and projectiles.

stands.name: Anubis
stands.text: A Stand inside a sword, kept alongside your normal Stand. Found only in desert pyramid chests.

moves.name: Draw
moves.short: Lunge and cut with your blade, parrying as it comes out.
moves.text: Right click with a blade: lunge and cut for 4-7. Parries as it comes out; a parried Draw counters for 6. 1.5s cooldown.

moves.name: Made For This
moves.short: Harmful effects wear off faster.
moves.text: Harmful effects wear off 1 second faster every 3 seconds, down to a floor of 2 seconds.

moves.name: Unorthodox Method
moves.short: This Stand grows by being out, not by kills.
moves.text: This Stand grows by being used. 1 point every 5 seconds it is out, rather than by killing with it.

moves.name: Swordsmanship
moves.short: Faster, longer, harder blade swings.
moves.text: Blade: 25% faster swings, +0.5 reach, +10% damage, cuts through walls. A parry leaves that foe taking +15% for 5s.

moves.name: Combat Adaptation
moves.short: Learns the attacks it meets and answers them.
moves.text: Learns each attack it meets: less damage, longer parries, then counters, then auto-parries mobs every 5s at 40% health or less. Fades out of sight.

blog.title: The website is live
blog.author: Gumel
blog.summary: Wiki, FAQ, roadmap and news for JoJo: Heaven's Arrow, all in one place.
blog.body:

- **Wiki** pages match the guide in our Discord server
- **FAQ** answers update whenever staff edit them in Discord
- **Roadmap** shows what is coming next

Join the Discord server for sneak peeks and announcements.
